faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper East houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Chilliwack Proper East sell for?
faq.a: 66 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper East between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $735,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Chilliwack Proper East sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 66 houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper East went for between $680,500 and $805,000, around a median of $735,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Chilliwack Proper East sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 66 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.3% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper East?
faq.a: The median year built was 1960 for the 66 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper East.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Chilliwack Proper East usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Chilliwack Proper East had 4 bedrooms, from the 66 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper East houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

66 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper East with a median price of $735,000 (the middle half sold between $680,500 and $805,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $379 per square foot, a median year built of 1960 and a median lot of 7,540 square feet.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper East compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median house in Chilliwack Proper East sold for $735,000, 11% below the Chilliwack median of $825,000 across 294 sales. Chilliwack Proper East houses took a median 24 days to sell, against 26 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
